rationale:
`assets/skills/habeas-bootstrap-requirements/SKILL.md` is a bundled skill with front matter, so it is a site of `requirements.cli.skill_conventions`.

The requirement has one MUST for each site: the description must state when to use the skill in terms of the user's task. The description in the front matter does this. It begins "Use when adopting Habeas in an existing codebase, when validation reports uncovered items across most of a project's code, or when the user asks for a requirements coverage audit." Those are user situations and requests.

The description also ends with "For a few uncovered items, use habeas-evidence." The requirement allows this with a MAY. `habeas-evidence` is a bundled skill, since `assets/skills/habeas-evidence` exists, and an agent could plausibly confuse it with this one.

No violation matches were listed, and I found no other gap.
